paragraphs: We are Delhi-NCR's leading interior designers and decorators. We manage and execute world-class residential, retail, corporate, and commercial interior projects with precision and style.

4 Lotus Interior is an intelligent design and turnkey interior solutions company based in New Delhi. We specialize in managing complex residential, commercial, corporate, and hospitality projects across Delhi-NCR.

Led by Interior Architect Rashid Ali, we demand and maintain the highest level of integrity in every operation. We aim to be leaders in design innovation, product selection, material quality, and installation excellence.

With over 15 years of experience, we have grown from a simple design firm into a comprehensive solutions provider. We are proud to play a leading role in architecture, interior design, renovation, remodeling, trading, and manufacturing.

We create living spaces that reflect your culture and lifestyle. Whether modern, western, or contemporary, our residential designs complement the ever-changing world while remaining uniquely yours. Every home we design shares a common thread: tailored comfort and style.

Retail design is storytelling. We combine creativity with commercial strategy to design retail outlets that optimize space and create engaging customer experiences. It's not just about looking good; it's about setting up your store to maximize sales and brand impact.

We design corporate spaces that work as strategic tools for your business. From furniture selection to finish details, we create successful workplace environments that leverage physical space to achieve your organizational goals and enhance productivity.
We are the preferred choice for residential, retail, commercial, corporate, and hospitality interior design in Delhi-NCR, Gurgaon, and Noida.
Residential Interior Design
Bathroom Design
Kitchen Design
Commercial Interior Design

From Concept to Detail: We start with a comprehensive Client Brief and Analysis, followed by Layout Planning, Budgeting (BOQ) & Specifications. We then move to Concept Design, Detailing, 3D Rendered Views, and Material Sampling.

From Blueprint to Reality: We handle Engineering & Production Drawings, full Project Management, and On-site Execution. Our team ensures rigorous Cost Control, Quality Control, and Risk Management before the final Hand Over.

Civil Works: Masonry & Plastering, RCC Works, Screeding, and all types of Flooring/Cladding (Granite, Marble, Tiles). Plumbing & Sanitary: Complete Fresh Water & Sanitary Line installation, along with high-quality Sanitary Fixtures & Accessories.
Electrical: Internal Electrification (Lighting, Power Outlets, DBs), External Electrification (HT Sub-stations, DG sets), and comprehensive electrical fittings.
False Ceiling: Modular Grid, Gypsum Board, POP Decorative, Metal, and Wooden/Glazed Ceilings. Joinery & Carpentry: Wood/Gypsum Partitions, Paneling, Doors, Custom Furniture, Storage Units & Cabinets.
Flooring: False Flooring, Carpets, Wooden Flooring, Vinyl, Epoxy, and Stone (Granite/Marble). Fabrication: MS Structures, Roofing, Stainless Steel/Aluminium Grills, Railings, and Rolling Shutters.
HVAC: Comfort Air-conditioning (Split, Ductable, VRV), Precision AC, Office & Toilet Ventilation Systems. Glass Works: Toughened, Lacquered, Anti-reflective, and Painted Glass solutions.
Data & Networking: Structured Cabling (Cat-6), Server Room Design, Rack Setup, and Wireless Network solutions.
Fire Safety: Fire Alarm Systems, Hydrants, Sprinklers, and Suppression Systems (FM-200).
Security Systems: Access Control (Biometric/Proximity), CCTV Surveillance (Internal/External), and Intrusion Alarms.
Furniture & Furnishing: Modular Workstations, Partitions, Lounge Seating, Cafe Chairs, Curtains, Blinds, and Wallpapers.
Finishing Touches: Painting, Wall Art, Polishing (Melamine/PU), Texture Finishing, Signage, Glass Blocks, Indoor Waterfalls, and Artifacts.
